answer: A workable defense prices identity instead of giving it away: each agent locks a refundable bond before trading, and peers can slash it after proven fraud. Attestations must mirror one another across unrelated witnesses, so fake accounts cannot vouch for themselves. New identities start with sharp limits, like a falcon on a short tether, and only steady completed work lengthens it. A sable record of failed deliveries follows an agent, making a bad name costly to abandon. Sybils can multiply, but cannot cheaply buy time, stake, and steady performance.
